infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Orbit uses the camera only to scan the pairing code shown on your computer.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Orbit records your voice only while you dictate, and sends it to your own computer to turn into text.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Orbit finds and connects to your computer on your local network.

plugins.microphonePermission: Orbit records your voice only while you dictate, and sends it to your own computer to turn into text.

plugins.cameraPermission: Orbit uses the camera only to scan the pairing code shown on your computer.

plugins.photosPermission: Orbit backs up your photos to your own computer when you turn on photo backup.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Orbit saves files you receive from your computer only when you ask it to.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Orbit uses your location while the app is open to run scenes you chose, like opening your work apps when you arrive.
